'''2020 TMW Pods Ming Huo LS Yavin 4 Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ming Huo]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Player:''' [[Ming Huo]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
